description: The paper test's three requests (the frontend's engine-aware design §13): each gets the common documents in the system message, which every call shares so the prompt cache can serve them, and its own in the user message, before the request.

requests.why: The design's §9 example: a block world, not particles, and a period-film look the plan must interpret, not quietly replace.

requests.text: a spiral galaxy, gold at the core and blue along the arms
requests.why: h1's ground, what Wexy builds today as particles: motion from a compute stage, glow from post.

requests.text: rolling hills under thick fog at dusk, the last light fading behind them
requests.why: Terrain and atmosphere: the environment family, unverified in H, with fog and a low sun.
